integrity: Single well-defined result with a fully embedded symbolic-and-interval checker. Numerical root values are descriptive, not certificates of uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The unique additional center coincidence and order reversal are proved only for height h in (7/10,4/5), not all triangle shapes. The proof uses explicit outward-rounded interval inequalities for the derivative; separate independent validation and historical priority review have not been performed.
title: A non-equilateral Spieker–Weber coincidence in an isosceles triangle
